title: Three Summers and One Short Crate
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：strawberry　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 strawberry 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the grower ① picked the strawberry that no buyer in the greenhouse would have counted, and he said the picking was the whole of the summer. The ② strawberry, meaning the berry itself and not the crate, ran three summers and stayed uncounted in the book; a strawberry, he said, is the only thing in a greenhouse that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ strawberry in that greenhouse had the same short crate beside it, and the ④ strawberry at the far shelf, meaning the bundle they kept for the children to tie and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A strawberry, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the grower said the counting is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the strawberry was the whole of the matter, meaning the sweetness and not the berry. The ⑥ strawberry, meaning the sweetness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; strawberry, he said, is either something you pick or the only word that means both a berry and a sweetness. He said the sweetness is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ strawberry had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short crate. The ⑧ strawberry of the whole thing, the grower wrote in August, was one greenhouse and three summers of counting; strawberry, he said, is either the bundle at the far shelf or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ strawberry I remember is the berry counted in the ledger, which closed in 1970 and is still counted as the quietest in the greenhouse. A ⑩ strawberry, my mother said in 1972, is the only berry that improves by being counted; every strawberry, she said, is a sweetness that has agreed to look like a berry. She said the sweetness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 草莓（指大棚里每一颗旁边的那一颗）
B. n. 草莓（指那颗草莓本身，与浅浅的木箱相对）
C. 固定搭配：pick the strawberry 摘这一颗草莓
D. n. 草莓（指留给孩子们捆的那一捆）
E. n. 草莓之事（抽象总称，指一处大棚的草莓之事）
F. n. 草莓（指收成账里写到、被清点的那一颗）
G. n. 草莓、甜头（指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 甜头（抽象总称，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: picked the strawberry that no buyer in the greenhouse would have counted
The strawberry, meaning the berry itself and not the crate
the strawberry at the far shelf
the strawberry was the whole of the matter
the strawberry had become a line in a ledger
The strawberry of the whole thing
A strawberry, my mother said in 1972

answers.why: pick the strawberry 意为“摘这一颗草莓”，1963 年那位种植户把大棚里没有一位收购人肯清点的一颗草莓做了一遍。
strawberry 意为“草莓”，指那颗草莓本身而不是浅浅的木箱，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被清点。
strawberry 意为“草莓”，指大棚里每一颗旁边的那一颗，每一颗旁边都有同一只浅浅的木箱。
strawberry 意为“草莓”，指最远那层架位的留给孩子们捆的那一捆，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
strawberry 意为“草莓、甜头”，指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这颗甜头就是那件事的全部。
strawberry 意为“甜头”，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西而不是那颗草莓，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
strawberry 意为“草莓”，指收成账里写到、被清点的那一颗，到 1968 年这一颗成了收成账里的一行。
strawberry 意为“草莓之事”，种植户八月写道，整件事的草莓之事是一处大棚和三个夏天的清点。
strawberry 意为“草莓”，我记得的是收成账里清点过的那一颗，1970 年收完了，至今仍被说成大棚里最安静的一颗。
strawberry 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，草莓是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的草莓。
